  AGENDA
  OF A REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities
Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request
a disability-related modification or accommodation.

The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Finance
Advisory Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each
person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as
specified by the Chairperson. Anyone wishing to address the Finance Advisory Committee is
requested to fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card
permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Finance Advisory Committee minutes
preparation.

The Finance Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairperson with concurrence of the
Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be
continued to future Committee meetings.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES

  1. Meeting of January 24, 2019

 COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items that are NOT on the
agenda. According to State law, no action can be taken by the Finance Advisory Committee on
matters presented under this section. If time is not adequate to hear all speakers, the remaining
speakers will be called upon at the conclusion of the meeting.

NEW AND OLD BUSINESS

  2. Presentation of OpenGov and discussion of pre-set reports imbedded in the platform
  City staff will present the deployment of OpenGov as launched on the City’s website, and the
  Committee will consider other/additional pre-set reports for the ease of the public.

  3. Review, Discuss Feedback and Finalization of the Committee’s projections and forecast for
  presentation to the City Council. The Committee Chair will lead and facilitate a review, discuss
  feedback from the January 24, 2019 meeting and incorporate changes/updates to the forecast;
  and discuss finalization of projection and forecast for presentation to the City Council.

  4. Review and Summarize Council’s discussion and/or conclusion of the February 12, 2019 and
  February 26, 2019 council meetings. No action required, only for discussion purposes.

ALSO PRESENT:  Finance Director Del Rosario, Budget Analyst Jimenez, Assistant to the City

  1. Meeting of November 29, 2018

NEW AND OLD BUSINESS

Finance Advisory Committee Meeting - Minutes
January 24, 2019
  Page 1 of 3
   2. Presentation of FY 2018-19 first quarter financial report and discussion of format and
  presentation
  Staff will present the first quarter financial results. The Committee will discuss the format and
  presentation of the data.

  3. Presentation of the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) ending June 30, 2018.
  Staff will provide an overview of the CAFR and respond to questions and discussion about the
  year-end results.

  4. Discussion of City meeting with Rancho Palos Verdes representatives
  The Chair, Vice Chair and staff will share information about what was learned in a meeting with
  representatives of Rancho Palos Verdes about how their Finance Advisory Committee works,
  relates to the City Council and staff, and work plan. Committee will discuss perspectives on
  their scope and responsibilities for moving forward.

  5. Review and consider the City’s Reserve Policy
  With the Operations Ad Hoc Committee, staff will present the findings and conclusions of the
  GFOA Risk Analysis Assessment for the Committee to consider and recommend changes to the
  City’s Reserve Policy.

  6. Equipment inventory status update
  City staff will provide an oral, status update on the City’s timeline for completing an inventory of
  equipment. No action is associated with this item.

  7. Review and consider GovInvest software for managing the City’s CalPERS obligations
  The Committee will take action on the CalPERS Ad Hoc recommendation for the GovInvest
  pension module for projecting, tracking and managing payments to CalPERS.

ACTION: On motion of Committee Member McGowan, seconded by Committee Member Culler,
approved to recommendation a 3-year GovInvest contract to the City Council. (5-0 in favor)

  8. Review and discuss the Committee’s projections and forecast of the City’s finances
  The Committee Chair will lead and facilitate a discussion of factors, figures, triggers and
  information for building and completing a model for projecting the City’s future fiscal needs.

  9. Presentation of OpenGov and discussion of pre-set reports imbedded in the platform
  City staff will present the deployment of OpenGov as launched on the City’s website, and the
  Committee will consider other/additional pre-set reports for the ease of the public.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATION

  i. None

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC – NONE
